This document outlines the reconditioning procedures P3, which must be performed 
after 2000 OP as indicated by OP 2000 at rated current in the title block.

Competence Requirement: to be carried out by trained staff or ALSTOM 
specialist. take the circuit breaker out of service, an opening of the pole 
columns is necessary .

Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety belts 
 ... etc.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The circuit breaker must be isolated and grounded from both sides..
The position indicator of the closing spring shows " discharged "
Isolate the service voltage and control voltage.
The appropriate local safety regulation should be observed.

Pump the Sf6 gas in the service unit and evacuate the column then ventilate 
 the pole column.

Wear rubber gloves , protective clothes , gas mask and breathing equipment 
 during the opening and cleaning.

Remove decompositions products after having opened the breaker (pole ) or any 
 subassembly.

Wipe off decompositions products with a piece of clothes or use a vacuum 
 cleaner.
Don't agitate decomposition products unnecessarily.

Neutralize deposits (arc products), adsorption filter and used clothes with a 
 3 % soda solution for 24 hours ,or dispose of as harmful substance.
